questions.question: You are at a restaurant with a friend. Your friend accidentally spills coffee on their jacket. Which response is the most appropriate?
options: It's fine, it happens to the best of us.
Oh no! That's terrible. Do you need any help cleaning it up?
Don't worry about it, I didn't see it coming.
You should have been more careful next time.
questions.answer: Oh no! That's terrible. Do you need any help cleaning it up?

questions.question: A colleague asks you for advice on how to improve your presentation skills. Which response best expresses your opinion?
options: I'm not sure, I've never given a presentation.
You should practice in front of a mirror every day.
I think you should try to make your slides more colourful.
That's a good idea, but you also need to speak clearly.
questions.answer: I think you should try to make your slides more colourful.

questions.question: You are talking to a stranger on a train who seems upset. They say, "I can't believe I missed my connection again." Which response is the most polite and empathetic?
options: Well, at least you got to your destination eventually.
That's awful. I'm sorry to hear that. Do you need a tissue?
You should have checked the departure times more carefully.
It's okay, you can take another train later.
questions.answer: That's awful. I'm sorry to hear that. Do you need a tissue?

questions.question: Your friend suggests going to a new café downtown this weekend. You are not sure if you want to go. Which response is the most natural?
options: I don't like cafés, I prefer eating at home.
That sounds interesting. What time are they opening?
No, I have to work all weekend.
Sure, why not? Let's go.
questions.answer: That sounds interesting. What time are they opening?

questions.question: You are writing a formal email to a professor asking for an extension on an assignment. Which phrase is the most appropriate for requesting the extension?
options: Can you give me more time to finish this?
I need a few more days to complete the project.
Please let me know if I can submit it late.
I'm sorry, but I can't do it by tomorrow.
questions.answer: I need a few more days to complete the project.
